messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added “Deal name” under “Reproduce a game.” Names now save and restore with progress, and unnamed saves still work.

Fixed pasted saves failing because their JSON fields appeared in a different order, while preserving validation.

Type checks, build, 150 unit/static tests, and 83 browser checks passed across the full run and focused reruns.

Changed files pass formatting. Repository-wide formatting reports existing issues in 13 unchanged files.
